# Warming Stripes Generator

This tool allows you to create **warming stripes** visualizations from your own temperature data. Warming stripes are a powerful visual way to show temperature change over time.

::: {.callout-note}
## How to use this tool

1. Upload a CSV file with two columns: year and annual mean temperature
2. Configure the reference period to calculate anomalies
3. Adjust visualization parameters according to your preferences
4. Generate and download your warming stripes visualization
:::

```{=html}
    <div class="warming-stripes-container">

            Specify the reference period to calculate anomalies and generate your warming stripes visualization.

                <div style="display: flex; height: 30px; border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb;" id="legendGradient"></div>

    <div id="tooltip" class="tooltip"></div>

    <script>
        const COLOR_PALETTES = {
            bluered: [
                '#08306b', '#08519c', '#2171b5', '#4292c6',
                '#6baed6', '#9ecae1', '#c6dbef', '#deebf7',
                '#fee0d2', '#fcbba1', '#fc9272', '#fb6a4a',

            ],
            default: [
                '#08306b', '#083d77', '#084383', '#084c8f', '#08519c', '#1459a3',
                '#1861aa', '#2169b1', '#2171b5', '#2979b9', '#3181be', '#3989c2',
                '#4292c6', '#4c9aca', '#569fce', '#60a7d2', '#6baed6', '#75b5d9',
                '#7fbddd', '#89c4e1', '#9ecae1', '#a6d0e5', '#b3d5e8', '#bfdaeb',

                '#e8eeef', '#f1ece7', '#fee5d9', '#fee0d3', '#fedfcd', '#fdd5c4',
                '#fcae91', '#fca589', '#fb9c7d', '#fb8370', '#fb6a4a', '#f86042',
                '#f5563b', '#f24934', '#ef3b2c', '#e63228', '#dd2e25', '#d42321',
                '#cb181d', '#c1121a', '#b20c16', '#a90813', '#99000d', '#91000b',
                '#800008', '#700007', '#600006', '#500005'
            ],
            viridis: [
                '#440154', '#450a5f', '#46146b', '#471e76', '#482878', '#46317d',
                '#453882', '#424186', '#3e4989', '#3c528c', '#395a8f', '#366291',
                '#31688e', '#2f708e', '#2c738e', '#2a7b8e', '#26828e', '#24898e',
                '#228e8d', '#20968c', '#1f9e89', '#22a386', '#2aa97b', '#2fae72',
                '#35b779', '#3dbf6e', '#4ac26d', '#55c667', '#6ece58', '#79d34f',
                '#7fd74e', '#86d949', '#8ad545', '#95d83e', '#a5db36', '#afdd30',
                '#b5de2b', '#bde028', '#c5e225', '#cde423', '#cbe627', '#d1e926',
                '#d7eb28', '#deed29', '#e3ef29', '#e9f12a', '#eef32a', '#f3f52b',
                '#f8f72c', '#fbf92d', '#fde724', '#fde724', '#fde724', '#fde724',
                '#fde724', '#fde724'
            ],
            plasma: [
                '#0d0887', '#1f0c8c', '#2a0593', '#3b0198', '#46039f', '#5102a3',
                '#5c01a6', '#6701a9', '#7201a8', '#7d09a5', '#8612a1', '#911c9d',
                '#9c179e', '#a72197', '#b02a8f', '#b93188', '#bd3786', '#c33e81',
                '#ca457c', '#d04c77', '#d8576b', '#de5d66', '#e16462', '#e76b5d',
                '#ed7953', '#f0814c', '#f68f46', '#f99740', '#fb9f3a', '#fca735',
                '#fcaf31', '#fdb72d', '#fdca26', '#fdd122', '#fdd724', '#fcdd24',
                '#fcdf25', '#fce325', '#fbe626', '#fae926', '#f9ed27', '#f8f027',
                '#f7f428', '#f6f728', '#f4fa29', '#f2fc2a', '#f0f921', '#f0f921',
                '#f0f921', '#f0f921', '#f0f921', '#f0f921', '#f0f921', '#f0f921',
                '#f0f921', '#f0f921'
            ],
            warm: [
                '#ffffcc', '#fffec0', '#fffdb3', '#fffca7', '#ffeda0', '#ffef96',
                '#fff18b', '#ffe780', '#fed976', '#fee76e', '#fee361', '#fedf54',
                '#feb24c', '#fea945', '#fea03e', '#fd9737', '#fd8d3c', '#fd8338',
                '#fd7933', '#fd6f2e', '#fc4e2a', '#f84626', '#f33f22', '#ee371e',
                '#e31a1c', '#dc181f', '#d41521', '#cc1323', '#bd0026', '#b20024',
                '#a60023', '#9a0021', '#8f001f', '#84001d', '#78001b', '#6d0019',
                '#800026', '#750023', '#6a0020', '#5f001d', '#550019', '#4a0016',
                '#400013', '#350010', '#2b000d', '#20000a', '#160007', '#0b0004',
                '#000000', '#000000', '#000000', '#000000', '#000000', '#000000',
                '#000000', '#000000'
            ]
        };

        let data = null;
        let displayData = null;
        let refMean = null;
        let selectedYearIndex = -1;
        let canvasContext = null;
        let chartParameters = null;

        document.getElementById('fileInput').addEventListener('change', handleFileUpload);
        document.getElementById('generateBtn').addEventListener('click', generateStripes);
        document.getElementById('resetBtn').addEventListener('click', resetForm);
        document.getElementById('downloadPNG').addEventListener('click', downloadPNG);
        document.getElementById('downloadSVG').addEventListener('click', downloadSVG);
        document.getElementById('exportConfig').addEventListener('click', exportConfiguration);
        document.getElementById('chartType').addEventListener('change', generateStripes);
        document.getElementById('colorPalette').addEventListener('change', generateStripes);

        function handleFileUpload(e) {
            const file = e.target.files[0];
            const messageDiv = document.getElementById('fileMessage');

            if (!file) return;

            const reader = new FileReader();
            reader.onload = function(event) {
                try {
                    const lines = event.target.result.split('\n').filter(line => line.trim());
                    const parsedData = [];

                    for (const line of lines) {
                        if (line.toLowerCase().includes('year') || line.toLowerCase().includes('temp')) {
                            continue;
                        }
                        
                        const parts = line.trim().split(/[,;]/).map(p => p.trim());
                        if (parts.length >= 2) {
                            const year = parseInt(parts[0]);
                            const temp = parseFloat(parts[1]);
                            if (!isNaN(year) && !isNaN(temp)) {
                                parsedData.push({ year, temp });
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    if (parsedData.length === 0) {
                        throw new Error('No valid data found in the file.');
                    }

                    data = parsedData.sort((a, b) => a.year - b.year);
                    const minYear = data[0].year;
                    const maxYear = data[data.length - 1].year;

                    document.getElementById('dataStart').value = minYear;
                    document.getElementById('dataEnd').value = maxYear;

                    showDataPreview(data);

                    messageDiv.className = 'message success';
                    messageDiv.textContent = `✓ File loaded: ${data.length} years of data (${minYear}-${maxYear})`;
                } catch (error) {
                    messageDiv.className = 'message error';
                    messageDiv.textContent = '✗ Error: ' + error.message;
                    data = null;
                    document.getElementById('dataPreview').style.display = 'none';
                }
            };
            reader.readAsText(file);
        }

        function showDataPreview(data) {
            const previewBody = document.getElementById('previewBody');
            const previewDiv = document.getElementById('dataPreview');
            
            previewBody.innerHTML = '';
            
            const maxRows = 10;
            const displayData = data.length > maxRows ? 
                [...data.slice(0, 5), ...data.slice(-5)] : data;
            
            displayData.forEach((d, index) => {
                if (index === 5 && data.length > maxRows) {
                    const row = previewBody.insertRow();
                    row.innerHTML = '<td colspan="2" style="text-align: center; padding: 6px; color: #6b7280;">...</td>';
                }
                const row = previewBody.insertRow();
                row.innerHTML = `
                    <td style="padding: 6px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e5e7eb;">${d.year}</td>
                    <td style="padding: 6px; text-align: right; border-bottom: 1px solid #e5e7eb;">${d.temp.toFixed(2)}</td>
                `;
            });
            
            previewDiv.style.display = 'block';
        }

        function generateStripes() {
            const messageDiv = document.getElementById('fileMessage');

            if (!data || data.length === 0) {
                messageDiv.className = 'message error';
                messageDiv.textContent = '✗ Please load a valid file first.';
                return;
            }

            try {
                const refStart = parseInt(document.getElementById('refStart').value);
                const refEnd = parseInt(document.getElementById('refEnd').value);
                const dataStart = parseInt(document.getElementById('dataStart').value);
                const dataEnd = parseInt(document.getElementById('dataEnd').value);
                const showLabels = document.getElementById('showLabels').checked;
                const labelInterval = parseInt(document.getElementById('labelInterval').value);
                const chartType = document.getElementById('chartType').value;

                if (isNaN(refStart) || isNaN(refEnd) || isNaN(dataStart) || isNaN(dataEnd)) {
                    throw new Error('All parameters must be numbers.');
                }

                if (refStart >= refEnd) {
                    throw new Error('Start year must be less than end year.');
                }

                if (dataStart > dataEnd) {
                    throw new Error('Data start year must be less than end year.');
                }

                const minDataYear = data[0].year;
                const maxDataYear = data[data.length - 1].year;
                
                if (refStart < minDataYear || refEnd > maxDataYear) {
                    throw new Error(`Reference period (${refStart}-${refEnd}) must be within available data range (${minDataYear}-${maxDataYear}).`);
                }

                const referenceData = data.filter(d => d.year >= refStart && d.year <= refEnd);
                displayData = data.filter(d => d.year >= dataStart && d.year <= dataEnd);

                if (referenceData.length === 0) {
                    throw new Error('No data in the specified reference period.');
                }

                if (displayData.length === 0) {
                    throw new Error('No data in the specified display period.');
                }

                refMean = referenceData.reduce((sum, d) => sum + d.temp, 0) / referenceData.length;
                const anomalies = displayData.map(d => d.temp - refMean);
                const minAnomaly = Math.min(...anomalies);
                const maxAnomaly = Math.max(...anomalies);
                const limit = Math.max(Math.abs(minAnomaly), Math.abs(maxAnomaly));
                
                const actualTemps = displayData.map(d => d.temp);
                const minTemp = Math.min(...actualTemps);
                const maxTemp = Math.max(...actualTemps);

                const selectedPalette = document.getElementById('colorPalette').value;
                const COLORS = COLOR_PALETTES[selectedPalette];

                const canvas = document.getElementById('canvas');
                const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
                const inputWidth = parseInt(document.getElementById('width').value);
                const stripesWidth = inputWidth * 0.5;
                const height = parseInt(document.getElementById('height').value);

                const horizontalPadding = 30;
                const titleHeight = 50;
                const labelHeight = showLabels ? 40 : 0;
                const canvasWidth = stripesWidth + (horizontalPadding * 2);
                canvas.width = canvasWidth;
                canvas.height = titleHeight + height + labelHeight;

                const startYear = displayData[0].year;
                const endYear = displayData[displayData.length - 1].year;

                ctx.fillStyle = '#505050';
                ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvasWidth, titleHeight);
                ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
                ctx.font = 'bold 20px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif';
                ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
                ctx.fillText(`Temperature change (${startYear}-${endYear})`, canvasWidth / 2, titleHeight / 2);

                const totalBarSpace = stripesWidth / displayData.length;

                if (chartType === 'stripes') {
                    displayData.forEach((d, index) => {
                        const anomaly = d.temp - refMean;
                        const normalized = (anomaly + limit) / (2 * limit);
                        const colorIndex = Math.floor(normalized * (COLORS.length - 1));
                        const color = COLORS[Math.max(0, Math.min(COLORS.length - 1, colorIndex))];

                        const xStart = Math.round(index * totalBarSpace) + horizontalPadding;
                        const xEnd = Math.round((index + 1) * totalBarSpace) + horizontalPadding;
                        const stripeWidth = xEnd - xStart + 1;

                        ctx.fillStyle = color;
                        ctx.fillRect(xStart, titleHeight, stripeWidth, height);
                    });

                    if (showLabels) {
                        ctx.fillStyle = '#505050';
                        ctx.fillRect(0, titleHeight + height, canvasWidth, labelHeight);

                        ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
                        ctx.font = 'bold 14px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif';
                        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                        ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';

                        displayData.forEach((d, index) => {
                            if (d.year % labelInterval === 0) {
                                const xPos = index * totalBarSpace + totalBarSpace / 2 + horizontalPadding;
                                ctx.fillText(d.year.toString(), xPos, titleHeight + height + labelHeight / 2);
                            }
                        });
                    }
                } else if (chartType === 'bars') {
                    const yAxisWidth = 50;
                    const chartStartX = horizontalPadding + yAxisWidth;
                    const chartWidth = stripesWidth - yAxisWidth;
                    const barSpace = chartWidth / displayData.length;
                    const barWidth = Math.max(1, barSpace * 0.8);
                    const barGap = barSpace - barWidth;
                    
                    const padding = 20;
                    const chartHeight = height - padding * 2;
                    const centerY = titleHeight + height / 2;
                    const maxBarHeight = chartHeight / 2;

                    ctx.fillStyle = '#4a5568';
                    ctx.fillRect(horizontalPadding, titleHeight, stripesWidth, height);

                    ctx.strokeStyle = '#6b7280';
                    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
                    ctx.font = '11px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif';
                    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
                    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';

                    const numTicks = 6;
                    for (let i = 0; i <= numTicks; i++) {
                        const value = limit - (i * (2 * limit) / numTicks);
                        const y = titleHeight + padding + (i * chartHeight / numTicks);
                        
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.moveTo(horizontalPadding + yAxisWidth - 5, y);
                        ctx.lineTo(horizontalPadding + stripesWidth, y);
                        ctx.stroke();
                        
                        ctx.fillText(value.toFixed(1), horizontalPadding + yAxisWidth - 8, y);
                    }

                    ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff';
                    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.moveTo(chartStartX, centerY);
                    ctx.lineTo(horizontalPadding + stripesWidth, centerY);
                    ctx.stroke();

                    displayData.forEach((d, index) => {
                        const anomaly = d.temp - refMean;
                        const normalized = (anomaly + limit) / (2 * limit);
                        const colorIndex = Math.floor(normalized * (COLORS.length - 1));
                        const color = COLORS[Math.max(0, Math.min(COLORS.length - 1, colorIndex))];

                        const barHeight = (anomaly / limit) * maxBarHeight;
                        const xPos = chartStartX + index * barSpace + barGap / 2;
                        
                        ctx.fillStyle = color;
                        if (barHeight >= 0) {
                            ctx.fillRect(xPos, centerY - barHeight, barWidth, barHeight);
                        } else {
                            ctx.fillRect(xPos, centerY, barWidth, -barHeight);
                        }
                    });

                    if (showLabels) {
                        ctx.fillStyle = '#505050';
                        ctx.fillRect(0, titleHeight + height, canvasWidth, labelHeight);

                        ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
                        ctx.font = 'bold 14px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif';
                        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                        ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';

                        displayData.forEach((d, index) => {
                            if (d.year % labelInterval === 0) {
                                const xPos = chartStartX + index * barSpace + barSpace / 2;
                                ctx.fillText(d.year.toString(), xPos, titleHeight + height + labelHeight / 2);
                            }
                        });
                    }
                }

                const n = displayData.length;
                const years = displayData.map(d => d.year);
                const temps = displayData.map(d => d.temp);
                
                const meanYear = years.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / n;
                const meanTemp = temps.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / n;
                
                let numerator = 0;
                let denominator = 0;
                for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    numerator += (years[i] - meanYear) * (temps[i] - meanTemp);
                    denominator += (years[i] - meanYear) * (years[i] - meanYear);
                }
                
                const slope = numerator / denominator;
                const warmingRatePerDecade = slope * 10;
                const totalTempChange = displayData[displayData.length - 1].temp - displayData[0].temp;
                
                document.getElementById('minTemp').textContent = minTemp.toFixed(2) + '°C';
                document.getElementById('maxTemp').textContent = maxTemp.toFixed(2) + '°C';
                document.getElementById('refMean').textContent = refMean.toFixed(2) + '°C';
                document.getElementById('minAnomaly').textContent = (minAnomaly >= 0 ? '+' : '') + minAnomaly.toFixed(2) + '°C';
                document.getElementById('maxAnomaly').textContent = (maxAnomaly >= 0 ? '+' : '') + maxAnomaly.toFixed(2) + '°C';
                document.getElementById('warmingRate').textContent = (warmingRatePerDecade >= 0 ? '+' : '') + warmingRatePerDecade.toFixed(3) + '°C/decade';
                document.getElementById('yearCount').textContent = displayData.length;
                document.getElementById('totalChange').textContent = (totalTempChange >= 0 ? '+' : '') + totalTempChange.toFixed(2) + '°C';

                updateColorLegend(COLORS, minAnomaly, maxAnomaly);
                
                chartParameters = {
                    chartType,
                    horizontalPadding,
                    stripesWidth,
                    titleHeight,
                    height,
                    labelHeight,
                    COLORS,
                    limit,
                    totalBarSpace,
                    canvasWidth,
                    canvasHeight: titleHeight + height + labelHeight
                };
                canvasContext = ctx;
                
                setupCanvasTooltip(canvas, displayData, refMean, chartType, horizontalPadding, stripesWidth, titleHeight, height, labelHeight);

                document.getElementById('outputSection').classList.add('active');
                messageDiv.className = '';
                messageDiv.textContent = '';
            } catch (error) {
                messageDiv.className = 'message error';
                messageDiv.textContent = '✗ Error: ' + error.message;
                document.getElementById('outputSection').classList.remove('active');
            }
        }

        function setupCanvasTooltip(canvas, displayData, refMean, chartType, horizontalPadding, stripesWidth, titleHeight, height, labelHeight) {
            const tooltip = document.getElementById('tooltip');
            const totalBarSpace = stripesWidth / displayData.length;

            canvas.onmousemove = function(e) {
                const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
                const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
                const y = e.clientY - rect.top;

                if (y < titleHeight || y > titleHeight + height) {
                    tooltip.classList.remove('active');
                    return;
                }

                const adjustedX = x - horizontalPadding;
                const index = Math.floor(adjustedX / totalBarSpace);
                
                if (index >= 0 && index < displayData.length && adjustedX >= 0 && adjustedX <= stripesWidth) {
                    const d = displayData[index];
                    const anomaly = d.temp - refMean;
                    
                    tooltip.innerHTML = `
                        <strong>Year:</strong> ${d.year}<br>
                        <strong>Temperature:</strong> ${d.temp.toFixed(2)}°C<br>
                        <strong>Anomaly:</strong> ${anomaly >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${anomaly.toFixed(2)}°C
                    `;
                    
                    let tooltipX = e.pageX + 10;
                    let tooltipY = e.pageY - 70;
                    
                    const tooltipWidth = 200;
                    const tooltipHeight = 70;
                    
                    if (tooltipX + tooltipWidth > window.pageXOffset + window.innerWidth) {
                        tooltipX = e.pageX - tooltipWidth - 10;
                    }
                    
                    if (tooltipX < window.pageXOffset) {
                        tooltipX = window.pageXOffset + 10;
                    }
                    
                    if (tooltipY < window.pageYOffset) {
                        tooltipY = e.pageY + 20;
                    }
                    
                    if (tooltipY + tooltipHeight > window.pageYOffset + window.innerHeight) {
                        tooltipY = e.pageY - tooltipHeight - 10;
                    }
                    
                    tooltip.style.left = tooltipX + 'px';
                    tooltip.style.top = tooltipY + 'px';
                    tooltip.classList.add('active');
                    
                    canvas.style.cursor = 'pointer';
                } else {
                    tooltip.classList.remove('active');
                    canvas.style.cursor = 'default';
                }
            };

            canvas.onmouseleave = function() {
                tooltip.classList.remove('active');
                canvas.style.cursor = 'default';
            };
        }

        function updateColorLegend(colors, minAnomaly, maxAnomaly) {
            const legendGradient = document.getElementById('legendGradient');
            legendGradient.innerHTML = '';
            
            colors.forEach(color => {
                const colorDiv = document.createElement('div');
                colorDiv.style.flex = '1';
                colorDiv.style.backgroundColor = color;
                legendGradient.appendChild(colorDiv);
            });
            
            document.getElementById('legendMin').textContent = minAnomaly.toFixed(2) + '°C';
            document.getElementById('legendMax').textContent = maxAnomaly.toFixed(2) + '°C';
        }

        function exportConfiguration() {
            if (!data || !displayData) {
                alert('Please generate a visualization first before exporting the configuration.');
                return;
            }

            const config = {
                metadata: {
                    exportDate: new Date().toISOString(),
                    version: '9.0',
                    description: 'Warming Stripes Generator Configuration'
                },
                parameters: {
                    referenceStart: parseInt(document.getElementById('refStart').value),
                    referenceEnd: parseInt(document.getElementById('refEnd').value),
                    dataStart: parseInt(document.getElementById('dataStart').value),
                    dataEnd: parseInt(document.getElementById('dataEnd').value),
                    width: parseInt(document.getElementById('width').value),
                    height: parseInt(document.getElementById('height').value),
                    chartType: document.getElementById('chartType').value,
                    colorPalette: document.getElementById('colorPalette').value,
                    showLabels: document.getElementById('showLabels').checked,
                    labelInterval: parseInt(document.getElementById('labelInterval').value)
                },
                statistics: {
                    referenceMean: refMean.toFixed(2),
                    minAnomaly: document.getElementById('minTemp').textContent,
                    maxAnomaly: document.getElementById('maxTemp').textContent,
                    yearCount: displayData.length,
                    dataRange: {
                        min: data[0].year,
                        max: data[data.length - 1].year
                    }
                },
                data: displayData.map(d => ({
                    year: d.year,
                    temperature: d.temp,
                    anomaly: (d.temp - refMean).toFixed(2)
                }))
            };

            const jsonStr = JSON.stringify(config, null, 2);
            const blob = new Blob([jsonStr], { type: 'application/json' });
            const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            const link = document.createElement('a');
            link.href = url;
            link.download = `warming-stripes-config-${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.json`;
            link.click();
            URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
        }

        function downloadPNG() {
            const canvas = document.getElementById('canvas');
            const link = document.createElement('a');
            link.href = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
            link.download = 'warming-stripes.png';
            link.click();
        }

        function downloadSVG() {
            if (!displayData || !refMean) {
                alert('Please generate a visualization first.');
                return;
            }

            const chartType = document.getElementById('chartType').value;
            const selectedPalette = document.getElementById('colorPalette').value;
            const COLORS = COLOR_PALETTES[selectedPalette];
            const showLabels = document.getElementById('showLabels').checked;
            const labelInterval = parseInt(document.getElementById('labelInterval').value);
            
            const inputWidth = parseInt(document.getElementById('width').value);
            const stripesWidth = inputWidth * 0.5;
            const height = parseInt(document.getElementById('height').value);
            const horizontalPadding = 30;
            const titleHeight = 50;
            const labelHeight = showLabels ? 40 : 0;
            const canvasWidth = stripesWidth + (horizontalPadding * 2);
            const canvasHeight = titleHeight + height + labelHeight;
            
            const startYear = displayData[0].year;
            const endYear = displayData[displayData.length - 1].year;
            
            const anomalies = displayData.map(d => d.temp - refMean);
            const minAnomaly = Math.min(...anomalies);
            const maxAnomaly = Math.max(...anomalies);
            const limit = Math.max(Math.abs(minAnomaly), Math.abs(maxAnomaly));
            
            let svg = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="${canvasWidth}" height="${canvasHeight}" viewBox="0 0 ${canvasWidth} ${canvasHeight}">
`;
            
            svg += `  <rect x="0" y="0" width="${canvasWidth}" height="${titleHeight}" fill="#505050"/>
`;
            
            svg += `  <text x="${canvasWidth / 2}" y="${titleHeight / 2}" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="middle" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" fill="#ffffff">Temperature change (${startYear}-${endYear})</text>
`;
            
            const totalBarSpace = stripesWidth / displayData.length;
            
            if (chartType === 'stripes') {
                displayData.forEach((d, index) => {
                    const anomaly = d.temp - refMean;
                    const normalized = (anomaly + limit) / (2 * limit);
                    const colorIndex = Math.floor(normalized * (COLORS.length - 1));
                    const color = COLORS[Math.max(0, Math.min(COLORS.length - 1, colorIndex))];
                    
                    const xStart = Math.round(index * totalBarSpace) + horizontalPadding;
                    const xEnd = Math.round((index + 1) * totalBarSpace) + horizontalPadding;
                    const stripeWidth = xEnd - xStart + 1;
                    
                    svg += `  <rect x="${xStart}" y="${titleHeight}" width="${stripeWidth}" height="${height}" fill="${color}"/>
`;
                });
                
                if (showLabels) {
                    svg += `  <rect x="0" y="${titleHeight + height}" width="${canvasWidth}" height="${labelHeight}" fill="#505050"/>
`;
                    
                    displayData.forEach((d, index) => {
                        if (d.year % labelInterval === 0) {
                            const xPos = index * totalBarSpace + totalBarSpace / 2 + horizontalPadding;
                            svg += `  <text x="${xPos}" y="${titleHeight + height + labelHeight / 2}" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="middle" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#ffffff">${d.year}</text>
`;
                        }
                    });
                }
            } else if (chartType === 'bars') {
                const yAxisWidth = 50;
                const chartStartX = horizontalPadding + yAxisWidth;
                const chartWidth = stripesWidth - yAxisWidth;
                const barSpace = chartWidth / displayData.length;
                const barWidth = Math.max(1, barSpace * 0.8);
                const barGap = barSpace - barWidth;
                
                const padding = 20;
                const chartHeight = height - padding * 2;
                const centerY = titleHeight + height / 2;
                const maxBarHeight = chartHeight / 2;
                
                svg += `  <rect x="${horizontalPadding}" y="${titleHeight}" width="${stripesWidth}" height="${height}" fill="#4a5568"/>
`;
                
                const numTicks = 6;
                for (let i = 0; i <= numTicks; i++) {
                    const value = limit - (i * (2 * limit) / numTicks);
                    const y = titleHeight + padding + (i * chartHeight / numTicks);
                    svg += `  <line x1="${horizontalPadding + yAxisWidth - 5}" y1="${y}" x2="${horizontalPadding + stripesWidth}" y2="${y}" stroke="#6b7280" stroke-width="1"/>
`;
                    svg += `  <text x="${horizontalPadding + yAxisWidth - 8}" y="${y}" text-anchor="end" dominant-baseline="middle" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#ffffff">${value.toFixed(1)}</text>
`;
                }
                
                svg += `  <line x1="${chartStartX}" y1="${centerY}" x2="${horizontalPadding + stripesWidth}" y2="${centerY}" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="2"/>
`;
                
                displayData.forEach((d, index) => {
                    const anomaly = d.temp - refMean;
                    const normalized = (anomaly + limit) / (2 * limit);
                    const colorIndex = Math.floor(normalized * (COLORS.length - 1));
                    const color = COLORS[Math.max(0, Math.min(COLORS.length - 1, colorIndex))];
                    
                    const barHeight = (anomaly / limit) * maxBarHeight;
                    const xPos = chartStartX + index * barSpace + barGap / 2;
                    
                    if (barHeight >= 0) {
                        svg += `  <rect x="${xPos}" y="${centerY - barHeight}" width="${barWidth}" height="${barHeight}" fill="${color}"/>
`;
                    } else {
                        svg += `  <rect x="${xPos}" y="${centerY}" width="${barWidth}" height="${-barHeight}" fill="${color}"/>
`;
                    }
                });
                
                if (showLabels) {
                    svg += `  <rect x="0" y="${titleHeight + height}" width="${canvasWidth}" height="${labelHeight}" fill="#505050"/>
`;
                    
                    displayData.forEach((d, index) => {
                        if (d.year % labelInterval === 0) {
                            const xPos = chartStartX + index * barSpace + barSpace / 2;
                            svg += `  <text x="${xPos}" y="${titleHeight + height + labelHeight / 2}" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="middle" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#ffffff">${d.year}</text>
`;
                        }
                    });
                }
            }
            
            svg += `</svg>`;
            
            const blob = new Blob([svg], { type: 'image/svg+xml' });
            const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            const link = document.createElement('a');
            link.href = url;
            link.download = 'warming-stripes.svg';
            link.click();
            URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
        }

        function resetForm() {
            document.getElementById('fileInput').value = '';
            document.getElementById('refStart').value = '1991';
            document.getElementById('refEnd').value = '2020';
            document.getElementById('dataStart').value = '';
            document.getElementById('dataEnd').value = '';
            document.getElementById('showLabels').checked = true;
            document.getElementById('labelInterval').value = '10';
            document.getElementById('chartType').value = 'stripes';
            document.getElementById('colorPalette').value = 'default';
            document.getElementById('outputSection').classList.remove('active');
            document.getElementById('fileMessage').className = '';
            document.getElementById('fileMessage').textContent = '';
            document.getElementById('dataPreview').style.display = 'none';
            data = null;
            displayData = null;
            refMean = null;
            selectedYearIndex = -1;
            canvasContext = null;
            chartParameters = null;
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>
```

## About Warming Stripes

**Warming stripes** were created by climatologist Ed Hawkins as a simple yet powerful visual way to communicate climate change. Each stripe represents a year, and the color indicates whether the temperature was cooler (blue) or warmer (red) than the average of the reference period.

### Tool Features

- **Custom data upload**: Upload your own temperature data in CSV format
- **Configurable reference period**: Define the baseline period to calculate anomalies
- **Multiple color palettes**: Choose from different color schemes
- **Two visualization types**: Traditional stripes or bar chart
- **Flexible export**: Download as PNG, SVG, or export configuration as JSON
- **Automatic statistics**: Calculates warming rates and anomalies

### Required Data Format

Your CSV file should have two columns:

```
year,temperature
1850,14.2
1851,14.3
1852,14.1
...
```

::: {.callout-tip}
## Data Sources

You can obtain temperature data from sources such as:

- [Berkeley Earth](http://berkeleyearth.org/data/)
- [NASA GISS](https://data.giss.nasa.gov/gistemp/)
- [NOAA](https://www.ncdc.noaa.gov/cag/)
- National meteorological services
:::

## References

- [Show Your Stripes](https://showyourstripes.info/) - Original project by Ed Hawkins
- Hawkins, E. (2018). "Warming stripes". Climate Lab Book.
